description: Measures one page again against the imported site, after your changes: Xodia's headless browser captures the page on this project and the same page on the imported project (about a minute; within the workspace's monthly headless allowance, like run_check) and compares them with Convert to React's own match. Answers the match per width and every section's score with its reason, worst first, the sections at 100, and which sections rose or dropped against the conversion. Colours and images aren't measured here (take_screenshot both pages). Use it in the repair loop: To lift a page: fix its worst section only, then check_match that page. Keep the change when that section rose and no other score dropped; otherwise undo it. Leave sections at 100 alone, and move sections with the site's own classes to Tailwind one at a time, checking after each. On a site rebuilt by hand, pass importedProjectId. headless_busy means try once more in about 30 seconds; open_in_xodia means the month's headless time is used up: don't call it again in this task. Skills tidy-converted-site and rebuild-imported-site.

importedPage.description: The same page on the imported project, when its path differs ("/about/" for "/about"). Default: page

importedProjectId.description: The project Import a website made. Default: the one this project was converted from

page.description: The page on this project, such as "/" or "/about/"

projectId.description: The project with the page to measure (the converted or rebuilt one)

width.description: Only this width in px (faster). Default: the widths the conversion compared, or the imported page's smallest, tablet and largest

name: check_match
title: Check match
